source: Original named, ground-centred multi-part workshop equipment. Blender metres, Z up, front -Y; root unit scale and identity quaternion. Dimensions constrained without distorting component proportions.
sourceCamera: Square 480 px orthographic reference. Two CPU threads, 12-sample Cycles with denoising; warm key, blue fill and rim.
export: Freshly reopened native model; bounded bevels and normals baked in memory. Joined static mesh with embedded PBR material partitions. GLB Y up, front +Z, no cameras, lights, game scripts, textures or animation clips. Emission marks the furnace fire.
comparison: Independent factory-empty Blender reimport checks triangle counts, area of each material region, base colors and world bounds. The disposable local TLS viewer renders the actual GLBs using a matched source camera in Firefox and Three.js.
staging: Isolated floor, ten proposed positions and frozen R02 room camera with identity rotations. Room actors, layers, HUD and runtime bindings are outside this capture.
